title: Ai-powered Full-stack Developer (Mandarin Speaker)
job_description:
Diploma/Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering or related IT field. 3+ years Full-Stack Development experience (web applications). Strong understanding of business logic and system flow. Able to work independently with minimal documentation (no heavy reliance on wireframes/PPT). Familiar with prompt engineering / AI-assisted coding tools. Strong problem-solving skills in high-concurrency systems.

Design and maintain backend APIs and system architecture. Develop and optimize database structure, queries, and data workflows. Handle high concurrency issues (duplication, deadlocks, system conflicts). Integrate BI tools and build data visualization dashboards. Manage third-party API integrations (logistics, payment, verification systems). Use AI tools to accelerate development, debugging, and code review

EPF SOCSO Medical benefits (if applicable). Performance-based growth opportunities. Exposure to AI-driven development environment.

Familiar with prompt engineering / AI-assisted coding tools.
